claim_boundary: The result establishes necessity of a persistent jointly writable state under the frozen synthetic architecture and resource rules. It does not prove that no possible communication protocol can emulate a workspace; recurrent message-state and external logs are explicitly classified as workspace-equivalent persistent memory.
known_limitations: The 16-slot shared state is explicitly supplied rather than learned as an emergent latent workspace.
The task is finite, synthetic, deterministic, and based on affine operators over GF(2)^4.
A recurrent message-state succeeds and is functionally equivalent to a shared workspace.
A complete external message log succeeds because it supplies persistent external integration memory.
The result cannot prove that no conceivable communication protocol could emulate a workspace.
The agents are small task-specific transformers rather than pretrained language models.
No pair autobiography persists after task completion.
No subjective-awareness, sentience, valence, merged-mind, or collective moral-status claim is supported.
next_unclosed_gap: Remove the explicit workspace representation and test whether separately trained agents spontaneously invent a compact recurrent joint latent under a bottleneck; discover and causally ablate it only after training.
